walkthroughs.body_html: Signed 1959 (effective 1961) by 12 nations; now 56 parties (29 consultative with full voting rights). Suspends 7 territorial claims. Bans military activity, mining (under Madrid Protocol 1991). Scientific stations: 70 year-round; UK Halley VI on Brunt Ice Shelf. Tourism 105000 visitors 2022/23.

Adopted 1982; entered force 1994. Sets territorial seas (12 nm), contiguous zone (24 nm), EEZ (200 nm). High Seas Treaty (2023) for 30 percent ocean protection by 2030. International Seabed Authority oversees deep-sea mining (controversial: Nauru triggered 2-yr rule 2021).

Outer Space Treaty 1967 (113 parties): celestial bodies for peaceful use only, no national appropriation. Liability Convention 1972. Artemis Accords (2020) US-led for Moon exploration; China/Russia not party. Space debris (34000+ tracked objects) and satellite traffic raise new challenges.
